assessment: This study advances a novel strategy of lineage tracing coupled with single-cell transcriptomics to allow unique insights into tumor heterogeneity and the diversity of response to treatment. These analyses reveal new insights into mechanisms of taxane resistance. Overall, the study is scientifically robust and puts forward a new methodology that will be of interest to scientists as well using this technology to gain insights into the factors that inform resistance to taxane treatment in an in vivo cancer model.
